# SHELLDON workspace notes

- This project is a Vite + React + TypeScript front end. Run it with `npm run dev`; validate with `npm run build` and `npm run lint`.
- Preserve the CRT terminal visual language and responsive behavior in `src/App.css` and `src/index.css`.
- The current wallet, agent, room, vote, and trade flows are explicitly demo-only. Do not present simulated state as confirmed on-chain activity.
- Keep chain integration, AI inference, custody, and trade execution behind clearly defined interfaces and require verified network configuration and explicit authorization before enabling transactions.
